label: Handmade 2D
name: Handmade 2D: paper, ink, held drawings
signature: Grain, irregular edges, line boil on twos
typical_failure: A texture filter over clean vectors

label: Editorial collage
name: Editorial collage: clippings, cut paper, halftone (Vox, Johnny Harris)
signature: Cutouts on a paper board, marker circles and arrows, typed labels, 12 fps
typical_failure: A slideshow of clip-art on beige

label: Motion graphics
name: Flat infographic, kinetic type, product UI film (Kurzgesagt, Apple, Linear)
signature: A strict system of type, shape and colour; type that moves with meaning; the real interface
typical_failure: Icons in coloured circles; invented UI; motion that makes words harder to read

label: Luminous 3D
name: Luminous 3D: dark space, light-emitting data, real depth
signature: Emissive accents, fog, a camera travelling macro to micro
typical_failure: Glowing shapes on a flat dark field

label: Realistic 3D
name: Realistic 3D: a photoreal or physically detailed world
suits: Places, machines, nature, anything that must read as real
signature: Real scale, materials, sky light, air, weighted motion
typical_failure: Reads as CGI: one-plane light, pillow rocks, sliding contacts

label: Character cartoon
name: Character cartoon, stick-figure doodle (CGP Grey, xkcd)
suits: Stories with a protagonist; opinion, humour, fast series
signature: A rigged cast acting; minimal figures with jokes in the drawing
typical_failure: Limbs lost in crops, a cast that changes scale; figures that stand still while the voice works

label: Line-art draw-on
name: Line-art draw-on (whiteboard)
signature: Strokes that draw themselves in narration order, a pull-back to the whole sketch
typical_failure: Clip-art icons, a pasted hand, one drawing speed

label: Map documentary
name: Map documentary (RealLifeLore, Wendover)
signature: An accurate map, routes drawing on, a camera flying between places
typical_failure: A wrong map, or a static map with arrows

label: Retro analog
name: Retro analog: VHS, CRT, early web, film
signature: Period type and UI, scanlines, chroma bleed, tape glitches on cuts

label: Others
name: Others: isometric, pixel art, painterly, clay look
suits: When the brief or a reference points there
